item.title: Giga Press Factory Expansion through a Digital Twin
item.description:
30-second summary

Debugging sequence and communication for the first time on physical equipment is expensive, so the project demonstrated why signal ownership and failure cases should be checked in a virtual environment first.

Team demo and report stage · Not measured in a live factory
Period / basis
10-person training team project · Public case updated Jul 2026
Project form
Virtual commissioning and data-flow PoC

Problem to solve

When PLC, SCADA, virtual equipment, and upper-layer data interpret the same signal differently, interlock, alarm, and communication errors surface late in commissioning.
